entities.summary: Ton Duc Thang University (TDTU) is a public university in Vietnam. The school belongs to the Vietnam General Confederation of Labor. The university operates under a comprehensive autonomy mechanism and currently maintains campuses in several cities, including Ho Chi Minh City, Khanh Hoa Province, and Lam Dong Province. Tôn Đức Thắng University is a university in Asia, established in 1997-09-24. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
